03 / Logo packages

The right level
of identity.

Choose a focused logo deliverable, a complete identity system, or a full brand setup. Every project can be tailored to your needs.

01 / Essentials

Basic Logo Design

Best for startups and businesses with a focused budget.

  • 2–3 initial design concepts
  • High-resolution PNG and JPG files
  • Vector and source files: AI, EPS, SVG and PDF
  • Transparent-background exports
  • 3 rounds of standard revisions
Ask about this package ↗
02 / Most complete

Complete Logo Package

Best for growing businesses ready for a consistent identity.

  • 3–5 initial design concepts
  • All vector and source files
  • Brand color palette with HEX, RGB and CMYK codes
  • Typography recommendations and hierarchy
  • Logo usage guidelines: do’s and don’ts
  • Social profile and cover graphics
  • Extended revisions
Ask about this package ↗
03 / Premium

Full Brand Identity

Best for a complete business launch or a brand evolution.

  • Full logo suite: primary, secondary, submarks and favicon
  • Complete brand book / style guide PDF
  • Custom color palette and typography system
  • Social media kit: templates, banners and avatars
  • Business card and letterhead design
  • Packaging or merchandise mockups
Discuss a custom package ↗

Package scope, revision limits, timelines and pricing are confirmed before each project begins. Trademark acceptance and legal clearance are not guaranteed by design deliverables.

04 / The point of view

Good design is more than looking good.

Your logo is often the first introduction to your business. It should feel intentional, communicate the right impression, and work wherever your customers meet your brand.

Logo List brings that thinking into every project: clear ideas, thoughtful design, and identity work made to help your business show up with confidence.
